entities.summary: Yeri Cruz Varela, known professionally as Yeri Mua, is a Mexican internet celebrity, singer, songwriter, and entrepreneur. She rose to popularity in 2018 for her live streams of makeup and cosmetics on Instagram and Facebook. In 2023, she embarked on a career as a reggaeton singer, notable for singles such as "Chupón" and "Línea del perreo."
